<!-- Styles -->
<style>
#chartdiv {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  /* cursor: grab; */
}
</style>


<!-- Resources -->
<script src="https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/index.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/map.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/geodata/worldUltra.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/themes/Animated.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.amcharts.com/lib/5/geodata/usaLow.js"></script>


<!-- Theme switcher -->
<script>
function applyTheme(theme) {
  const t = (theme || 'light').toLowerCase();
  document.getElementById('vars-light').disabled       = (t !== 'light');
  document.getElementById('vars-light-warm').disabled  = (t !== 'light-warm');
  document.getElementById('vars-light-cool').disabled  = (t !== 'light-cool');
  document.getElementById('vars-dark').disabled        = (t !== 'dark');
  document.getElementById('vars-dark-warm').disabled   = (t !== 'dark-warm');
  document.getElementById('vars-dark-cool').disabled   = (t !== 'dark-cool');
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t;
}
applyTheme(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('theme'));  // initial theme
</script>


<!-- Helper to convert colors to am5.color()-->
<script>  // Helper to read CSS variable as am5.color(), with fallback
function cssVar(varName, fallback = '#000000') {
  const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(varName).trim() || fallback;
  if (raw.startsWith('#')) return am5.color(parseInt(raw.replace('#','0x')));
  const m = raw.match(/rgba?\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)/i);
  return m ? am5.color((+m[1]<<16) | (+m[2]<<8) | (+m[3])) : am5.color(parseInt(fallback.replace('#','0x')));
}
</script>



<!-- Chart code -->
<script>
am5.ready(function() {
  function applyTheme(theme) {
    const t = (theme || 'light').toLowerCase();
    document.getElementById('vars-light').disabled       = (t !== 'light');
    document.getElementById('vars-light-warm').disabled  = (t !== 'light-warm');
    document.getElementById('vars-light-cool').disabled  = (t !== 'light-cool');
    document.getElementById('vars-dark').disabled        = (t !== 'dark');
    document.getElementById('vars-dark-warm').disabled   = (t !== 'dark-warm');
    document.getElementById('vars-dark-cool').disabled   = (t !== 'dark-cool');
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t;
  }
  // initial from query param
  applyTheme(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('theme') || 'light');

  const MAP_MARKER_URL = new URL('/system/webdev/BH/globe/mapMarkers', window.location.origin);

  // Create root element
  var root = am5.Root.new("chartdiv");

  // Set themes
  root.setThemes([
    am5themes_Animated.new(root),
    am5.Theme.new(root, {
      rule: (target) => target instanceof am5.Container,
      overrides: {
        cursor: "grab"
      }
    })
  ]);

  // Create the map chart
  var chart = root.container.children.push(am5map.MapChart.new(root, {
    panX: "rotateX",
    panY: "rotateY",
    projection: am5map.geoOrthographic(),
  }))

  // Background
  var backgroundSeries = chart.series.push(am5map.MapPolygonSeries.new(root, {}));
  backgroundSeries.mapPolygons.template.setAll({
    fill: cssVar('--globe-ocean', '#A2A9B0'),
    stroke: cssVar('--globe-ocean', '#A2A9B0'),
    fillOpacity: 0.8,
    strokeOpacity: 1,
    interactive: false,
    cursorOverStyle: "grab"
  });

  backgroundSeries.data.push({
    geometry: am5map.getGeoRectangle(90, 180, -90, -180)
  });

  var graticuleSeries = chart.series.push(am5map.GraticuleSeries.new(root, { step: 10 }));
  graticuleSeries.mapLines.template.setAll({
    strokeOpacity: 0.1,
    cursorOverStyle: "grab"
  });

  // Countries
  var worldSeries = chart.series.push(am5map.MapPolygonSeries.new(root, {
    geoJSON: am5geodata_worldUltra
  }));

  worldSeries.mapPolygons.template.setAll({
    tooltipText: "{name}",
    toggleKey: "active",
    interactive: true,
    fill: cssVar('--globe-land', '#DDE1E6'),
    stroke: cssVar('--globe-land-stroke', '#4D5358'),
    strokeOpacity: 0.3,
    strokeWidth: 1,
    cursorOverStyle: "default"
  });

  worldSeries.mapPolygons.template.states.create("active", {
    fill: cssVar('--globe-land-active', '#C1C7CD')
  });

  var usaSeries = chart.series.push(am5map.MapPolygonSeries.new(root, {
    geoJSON: am5geodata_usaLow
  }));

  usaSeries.mapPolygons.template.setAll({
    fill: cssVar('--globe-land', '#DDE1E6'),
    fillOpacity: 0,
    stroke: cssVar('--globe-land-stroke', '#4D5358'),
    strokeOpacity: 0.3,
    strokeWidth: 0.8,
    cursorOverStyle: "grab"
  });

  usaSeries.mapPolygons.template.states.create("active", {
    fill: cssVar('--globe-land-active', '#C1C7CD')
  });

  // Rotate-to-country
  var previousPolygon;
  worldSeries.mapPolygons.template.on("active", function(active, target) {
    if (previousPolygon && previousPolygon != target) previousPolygon.set("active", false);
    if (target.get("active")) selectCountry(target.dataItem.get("id"));
    previousPolygon = target;
  });

  function selectCountry(id) {
    let dataItem = worldSeries.getDataItemById(id);
    let target = dataItem.get("mapPolygon");
    if (target) {
      let centroid = target.geoCentroid();
      if (centroid) {
        chart.animate({ key: "rotationX", to: -centroid.longitude, duration: 1500, easing: am5.ease.inOut(am5.ease.cubic) });
        chart.animate({ key: "rotationY", to: -centroid.latitude,  duration: 1500, easing: am5.ease.inOut(am5.ease.cubic) });
      }
    }
  }

  function loadCenter() {
    chart.animate({ key: "rotationX", to: 83, duration: 1500, easing: am5.ease.inOut(am5.ease.cubic) });
    chart.animate({ key: "rotationY", to: -40,  duration: 1500, easing: am5.ease.inOut(am5.ease.cubic) });
  }

  // Pre-center on US (optional)
  worldSeries.events.on("datavalidated", function() { loadCenter(); });

  // ---- ADDED: Point series (empty for now) ----
  let pointSeries = chart.series.push(am5map.MapPointSeries.new(root, {
    latitudeField: "lat",
    longitudeField: "lng"
  }));
  
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ---------------------------------------TOOLTIP ICONS-------------------------------------------
  function makeTwoToneIcon(root, bgPath, bgHex, fgPath, fgHex, size=14) {
    let c  = am5.Container.new(root, { width: size, height: size });
    let bg = am5.Graphics.new(root, {
      svgPath: bgPath, width: size, height: size,
      fill: am5.color(parseInt(bgHex.replace("#","0x"))), strokeOpacity: 0
    });
    let fg = am5.Graphics.new(root, {
      svgPath: fgPath, width: size, height: size,
      fill: am5.color(parseInt(fgHex.replace("#","0x"))), strokeOpacity: 0
    });
    c.children.push(bg); c.children.push(fg);
    return c;
  }

  // dictionary: key = fill hex, value = factory(root, size) → Container
  const ICONS = {
    "#E22028": (root, size=14) => makeTwoToneIcon(
      root,
      "M0 0H24V24H0V0Z", "#E22028",
      "M5.4 12.0101C5.4 10.6233 5.69677 9.38457 6.29032 8.29397C6.89677 7.1899 7.71613 6.33492 8.74839 5.72903C9.79355 5.10968 10.9613 4.8 12.2516 4.8C13.7613 4.8 15.0839 5.20393 16.2194 6.01178C17.3548 6.81964 18.1484 7.93717 18.6 9.36438H15.4839C15.1742 8.69116 14.7355 8.18626 14.1677 7.84965C13.6129 7.51304 12.9677 7.34474 12.2323 7.34474C11.4452 7.34474 10.7419 7.53997 10.1226 7.93043C9.51613 8.30743 9.03871 8.846 8.69032 9.54614C8.35484 10.2463 8.1871 11.0676 8.1871 12.0101C8.1871 12.9391 8.35484 13.7604 8.69032 14.4741C9.03871 15.1742 9.51613 15.7195 10.1226 16.11C10.7419 16.487 11.4452 16.6755 12.2323 16.6755C12.9677 16.6755 13.6129 16.5072 14.1677 16.1705C14.7355 15.8205 15.1742 15.3088 15.4839 14.6356H18.6C18.1484 16.0763 17.3548 17.2006 16.2194 18.0084C15.0968 18.8028 13.7742 19.2 12.2516 19.2C10.9613 19.2 9.79355 18.8971 8.74839 18.2912C7.71613 17.6718 6.89677 16.8168 6.29032 15.7262C5.69677 14.6356 5.4 13.3969 5.4 12.0101Z",
      "#FFFFFF", size
    ),
    "#EC8629": (root, size=14) => makeTwoToneIcon(
      root,
      "M12 0L24 24H0L12 0Z", "#EC8629",
      "M16.8 10.8V22.8H14.4788V17.694H9.52124V22.8H7.2V10.8H9.52124V15.7341H14.4788V10.8H16.8Z",
      "#000000", size
    ),
    "#F5E11B": (root, size=14) => makeTwoToneIcon(
      root,
      "M0 0H24L12 24L0 0Z", "#F5E11B",
      "M16.8 1.2V12H15.0339V4.97536L12.6749 12H11.3377L8.9661 4.97536V12H7.2V1.2H9.20578L12.0063 9.23037L14.8068 1.2H16.8Z",
      "#000000", size
    ),
    "#916AAD": (root, size=14) => makeTwoToneIcon(
      root,
      "M12 0L24 12L12 24L0 12L12 0Z", "#916AAD",
      "M10.8 15.6H15.6V16.8H8.4V6H10.8V15.6Z",
      "#FFFFFF", size
    )
  };
  const getIconFactory = (hex) => ICONS[(hex||"").toUpperCase()] || null;

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const tooltip = am5.Tooltip.new(root, {
    getFillFromSprite: false,
    keepTargetHover: true,
    pointerOrientation: "horizontal",
    interactive: true
    });

  // background + size
  tooltip.get("background").setAll({
    fill: cssVar('--neutral-10', '#FFFFFF'),
    stroke: cssVar('--globe-land-stroke', '#4D5358'),
    cornerRadius: 6,
    strokeOpacity: 0.3
  });

  tooltip.setAll({
    width: 220, height: 60,
    minWidth: 220, minHeight: 60,
    maxWidth: 220, maxHeight: 60
  });

  tooltip.label.setAll({ text: "", visible: true, forceHidden: false });

//  tooltip content
  let col = tooltip.children.push(am5.Container.new(root, {
    layout: root.verticalLayout,
    width: 210,
    height: 50,
    position: "absolute",
    paddingLeft: 5, paddingRight: 5, paddingTop: 5, paddingBottom: 5
  }));

// ------
  let row0 = am5.Container.new(root, {
    layout: root.horizontalLayout,
    width: 210,
    height: 25,
    paddingLeft: 5, paddingRight: 0, paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0,
    position: "relative",
    centerY: am5.percent(25),
    cornerRadius: 50,
    background: am5.RoundedRectangle.new(root, {
      fill: cssVar('--neutral-80', '#343A3F'),
      fillOpacity: 1,
      cornerRadiusTL: 6, cornerRadiusTR: 6, cornerRadiusBL: 0, cornerRadiusBR: 0
    })
  });

  const buildingIcon = am5.Graphics.new(root, {
    svgPath: "M17,11V3H7v4H3v14h8v-4h2v4h8V11H17z M7,19H5v-2h2V19z M7,15H5v-2h2V15z M7,11H5V9h2V11z M11,15H9v-2h2V15z M11,11H9V9h2 V11z M11,7H9V5h2V7z M15,15h-2v-2h2V15z M15,11h-2V9h2V11z M15,7h-2V5h2V7z M19,19h-2v-2h2V19z M19,15h-2v-2h2V15z",
    width: 14, height: 14, fill: cssVar('--neutral-10', '#FFFFFF'),
    position: "relative"
  });

  let nameLabel = am5.Label.new(root, {
    text: "",  // we'll set this on show
    fontSize: 15,
    fontWeight: "500",
    fill: cssVar('--neutral-10', '#FFFFFF'),
    paddingTop: 0,
    paddingLeft: 6,
    centerY: am5.percent(50),
    y: am5.percent(50),
    ellipsis: "…",
    position: "relative"
  });

// after you create row0 and add (buildingIcon, nameLabel)
  let alarmIconHolder = am5.Container.new(root, {
    width: 14, height: 14,
    centerY: am5.percent(0),
    centerX: am5.percent(100),
    y: am5.percent(0),
    x: am5.percent(95),
    position: "relative"
    // paddingLeft: 8
  });

  row0.children.push(buildingIcon);
  row0.children.push(nameLabel);
  row0.children.push(alarmIconHolder);   // last child ✅

// ------

  let row1 = am5.Container.new(root, {
    layout: root.horizontalLayout,
    width: 210,
    height: 25,
    paddingLeft: 5, paddingRight: 5, paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0,
    position: "relative",
    centerY: am5.percent(75),
    cornerRadius: 50,
    background: am5.RoundedRectangle.new(root, {
      fill: cssVar('--neutral-90', '#21272A'),
      fillOpacity: 1,
      cornerRadiusBL: 6, cornerRadiusBR: 6, cornerRadiusTL: 0, cornerRadiusTR: 0
    })
  });

  const row1_label = am5.Label.new(root, {
    text: "Status",
    fontSize: 17,
    fontWeight: "300",
    fill: cssVar('--neutral-10', '#FFFFFF'),
    position: "relative",
    centerY: am5.percent(50),
    y: am5.percent(50)
  });


  let row1_status = am5.Label.new(root, {
    text: "Normal",                  // we'll set this on show
    fontSize: 17,
    fontWeight: "600",
    fill: cssVar('--globe-marker', '#114599'),
    position: "relative",
    centerY: am5.percent(50),
    y: am5.percent(50),
    centerX: am5.percent(100),
    x: am5.percent(100)
  });
  row1.children.push(row1_label);
  row1.children.push(row1_status);

  col.children.push(row0);
  col.children.push(row1);

  tooltip.get("background").setAll({
    pointerLength: 0,      // hide the little arrow
    pointerBaseWidth: 0    // (belt + suspenders)
  });

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function setAlarmIcon(fillColorOrHex) {
    // normalize to hex string like "#EC8629"
    let hex = (typeof fillColorOrHex === "string")
      ? fillColorOrHex
      : (fillColorOrHex && fillColorOrHex.toString ? fillColorOrHex.toString() : "");

    alarmIconHolder.children.clear();
    let make = getIconFactory(hex);
    if (make) {
      let icon = make(root, 14);    // fresh instance
      alarmIconHolder.children.push(icon);
    }
  }

  // ---------------- MARKERS ----------------
  pointSeries.bullets.push(function(root, series, dataItem) {
    let di = dataItem || {};
    let dc = di.dataContext || {};
    var g = am5.Graphics.new(root, {
      id: dc.name,
      svgPath: "M18 3C12.195 3 7.5 7.695 7.5 13.5c0 7.875 10.5 19.5 10.5 19.5s10.5-11.625 10.5-19.5c0-5.805-4.695-10.5-10.5-10.5z",
      width: 36,
      height: 36,
      centerX: am5.p50,
      centerY: am5.p100,
      tooltipY: -30,
      stroke: am5.color(0xffffff),
      fill: "{fill}",
      fillOpacity: 1,
      strokeWidth: 1,
      cursorOverStyle: "pointer",
      tooltip: tooltip,
      // tooltipX = 
      tooltipText: " "  // we'll set this on show
      });

    g.set("rotation", rotationsById[dc.id] || 0);  // ⟵ use current rotation

    // Drive fill from the datum
    g.adapters.add("fill", function(_fill, target) {
      // support either hex string like "#FF0000" or number 0xFF0000
      if (typeof dc.fill === "string")   return am5.color(parseInt(dc.fill.replace("#","0x")));
      if (typeof dc.fill === "number")   return am5.color(dc.fill);
      return cssVar('--globe-marker', '#114599');
    });

    g.setAll({
      viewPath: dc.viewPath,
      tagPath:  dc.tagPath
    });

    if(g.get("fill").toString() === "#ec8629") {
      g.animate({ key: "fillOpacity", to: 0.1, duration: 1500, loops: Infinity, easing: am5.ease.yoyo(am5.ease.sine) });
    }
    else {
      g.set("fillOpacity", 1);
    }

    g.events.on("pointerover", () => {
      nameLabel.set("text", dc.name ? String(dc.name) : "");
      // nameLabel.set("text", g.get("x"));
      row1_status.set("text", g.get("fill").toString() === "#ec8629" ? "Alarm" : "Normal");
      let hex = g.get("fill").toString().toUpperCase();
      setAlarmIcon(hex);
    });

    g.events.on("click", () => {
      var navUrl = (MAP_MARKER_URL instanceof URL ? MAP_MARKER_URL : new URL(MAP_MARKER_URL, window.location.href));

      fetch(navUrl.toString(), {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        headers: {
          "Accept": "application/json",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({viewPath: dc.viewPath, tagPath: dc.tagPath})
      })
    });
    return am5.Bullet.new(root, { sprite: g });
    });



  function rowFromFeature(f) {
    const lat = f.geometry.coordinates[1];
    const lng = f.geometry.coordinates[0];
    return {
      id:  f.properties.name,
      fill: f.properties.color,
      name: f.properties && f.properties.name ? f.properties.name : "",
      lat, lng,
      viewPath: f.properties.viewPath,
      tagPath:  f.properties.tagPath
    };
  }

// --- ROTATION HELPERS (proximity-based) ---
    const ROT_THRESHOLD_DEG = 5;   // ±5° box in both lat & lon
    const ROT_LEFT  = -10;
    const ROT_RIGHT =  10;

    // will be updated on every load; keyed by marker id
    let rotationsById = Object.create(null);

/**
 * Build groups of points that are mutually "near" each other
 * using a simple rectangular proximity test (±threshold in both lat & lon).
 * Returns an array of arrays (groups), each group is a list of rows.
 */
    function groupNearby(rows, threshold = ROT_THRESHOLD_DEG) {
        const groups = [];
        const unvisited = new Set(rows.map(r => r.id));
        const byId = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.id, r]));

    // adjacency by rectangular proximity
    function neighborsOf(r) {
        const res = [];
        for (const s of rows) {
        if (s.id === r.id) continue;
        if (Math.abs(s.lat - r.lat) <= threshold && Math.abs(s.lng - r.lng) <= threshold) {
            res.push(s);
        }
        }
        return res;
    }

    // flood-fill to make groups
    for (const id of [...unvisited]) {
        if (!unvisited.has(id)) continue;
        const start = byId.get(id);
        const queue = [start];
        const group = [];
        unvisited.delete(id);

        while (queue.length) {
        const cur = queue.pop();
        group.push(cur);
        for (const n of neighborsOf(cur)) {
            if (unvisited.has(n.id)) {
            unvisited.delete(n.id);
            queue.push(n);
            }
        }
        }
        if (group.length > 1) groups.push(group);
    }
    return groups;
    }

    /**
     * Compute rotations: in each group, sort by longitude; west-most = -30°, east-most = +30°.
     * Middle items (if any) = 0°.
     */
    function computeRotations(rows) {
    const rot = Object.create(null);

    // default 0° for everyone
    for (const r of rows) rot[r.id] = 0;

    const groups = groupNearby(rows, ROT_THRESHOLD_DEG);
    for (const g of groups) {
        // sort by longitude (west -> east)
        const sorted = [...g].sort((a, b) => a.lng - b.lng);
        if (sorted.length >= 2) {
        rot[sorted[0].id]              = ROT_LEFT;   // west-most
        rot[sorted[sorted.length-1].id]= ROT_RIGHT;  // east-most
        // middle ones remain 0
        }
    }
    return rot;
    }

    /** Apply any rotations we’ve computed to existing sprites */
    function applyRotationsToSeries() {
    pointSeries.dataItems?.forEach(di => {
        const id = di.get("id") || di.dataContext?.id;
        const rotation = rotationsById[id] || 0;
        // first bullet only; you create one per dataItem
        const bullet = di.bullets?.[0];
        const sprite = bullet && bullet.get("sprite");
        if (sprite) sprite.set("rotation", rotation);
    });
    }

  
    function upsertPoints(rows) {
        const seen = new Set();
        rows.forEach(r => {
            seen.add(r.id);

            const di = pointSeries.getDataItemById(r.id);

            if (di) {
            di.setAll({ latitude: r.lat, longitude: r.lng, fill: r.fill });

            const dc = di.dataContext || {};
            Object.assign(dc, r);
            di.dataContext = dc;

            const b = di.bullets?.[0];
            const z = b && b.get("sprite");
            if (z) {
                // refresh fill-dependent animation
                z.set("fill", z.get("fill"));
                if (z.get("fill").toString() === "#ec8629") {
                z.animate({ key: "fillOpacity", to: 0.1, duration: 1500, loops: Infinity, easing: am5.ease.yoyo(am5.ease.sine) });
                } else {
                z.set("fillOpacity", 1);
                }
            }

            } else {
            pointSeries.data.push(r);
            }
        });

    // (Re)compute rotations for the *current* rows and apply them
    rotationsById = computeRotations(rows);
    applyRotationsToSeries();
    }






  // Fetch and map GeoJSON -> { name, lat, lng }
  function loadDataCenters() {
    const url = (MAP_MARKER_URL instanceof URL ? MAP_MARKER_URL : new URL(MAP_MARKER_URL, window.location.href));

    fetch(url.toString(), {
      method: "GET",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
    })
    .then(r => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(fc => {
      const rows = fc.features.map(rowFromFeature);
      upsertPoints(rows);            // ← update in place (no .setAll)
      return rows;
    })
    .catch(err => {
      console.error("Failed to load data centers:", err);
      // On error, leave existing points alone (no teardown)
      // If you want to mark them "stale", you could toggle a flag in dataContext here.
    });
  }

  // Listen for "alarm or theme" changes pushed by Perspective
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
    const m = /theme=(\w+)/i.exec(location.hash);
    if (m) applyTheme(m[1]);
    loadDataCenters();
  });

  // Kick it off
  loadDataCenters();



  // Make stuff animate on load
  chart.appear(1000, 100);
}); // end am5.ready()
</script>
